load_bertscore_metric: load the bertscore evaluation metric module using evaluate.load for comparing text similarity
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for the bertscore metric to compare predictions against references
compute_bertscore: compute bertscore metrics including precision, recall, and F1 scores between prediction and reference texts
compare_text_similarity: compare prediction and reference texts using bertscore embeddings to measure semantic similarity
evaluate_model_outputs: evaluate model-generated text against reference text using bertscore precision, recall, and F1 scores
